title: Immersive Weathering Leaf Piles Fix
description: Fixes colour and other errors with generated leaf piles for modded leaf blocks in Immersive Weathering.
body:
[Immersive Weathering](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-weathering) by Silversmith mods has an issue (possibly caused by Moonlight Lib) that causes many heavy leaf piles of modded leaf blocks to have distorted colours. There are also limitations to how models and textures are generated for leaf blocks with multiple layers, such as for flowers or fruits that do not follow biome colours while the leaves do.

This resource pack aims to fix this by adding explicit textures for as many modded leaf blocks as possible.

* Heavy leaf piles have proper colours.
* Leaf piles with layers or other special visual behaviours appear properly.
* Where a modded leaf block texture is clearly edited from a vanilla leaf block in a reproducible way, IW's own bespoke leaf pile textures for the corresponding vanilla block are used as a base.
* The same logic is applied to bark items based on log block textures.
* Where language files are used in the original mod to give names to items that don't match their IDs, IW uses the ID for its generated items rather than the names as defined in the language file. This is corrected so that names are consistent (also includes IW bark items).
